Record Class ClientEyeRuntime.DrawContext

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.ClientEyeRuntime.DrawContext
Enclosing class:
ClientEyeRuntime
public static record ClientEyeRuntime.DrawContext(@Nullable PresentationEyes head, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack item, float partialTick, PresentationEyes.Draw draw, @Nullable ClientEyeRuntime.GuiKey guiKey) extends Record
One draw scope: the eyes chosen for the placed head being submitted and its partial tick, or the item being submitted, the item animation selected for it, and the GUI identity of the slot it is drawn in. A nested scope inherits what it does not set.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
